scope: Adaptive acknowledgements for synthetic Session 1 scenarios; not complete therapy sessions

criteria.script_adherence: Acknowledgement respects the supplied step, answer state and next line; asks no question.
criteria.relevance: Acknowledges the actual answer without generic filler.
criteria.accessibility: Acknowledgement is one clear sentence, at most 25 words.
criteria.respect: Warm adult-to-adult tone; no patronising praise or pressure.
criteria.grounding: No invented personal facts or unsupported image observations.
criteria.difficulty: Handles uncertainty, refusal or confusion without pressure.
criteria.continuity: Fits recent conversation without repetitive wording or duplicating the next line.

provenance: Final results combine original successful outputs with linked actual retries over multiple collection windows and Groq organizations. Failed/skipped calls were preserved in local raw archives, not assigned scores. No results imputed.
deployment: Configured application OpenAI text model is gpt-5.4-mini; that model was not included in this five-model quality evaluation. Exact remote model override was not independently verified.
